answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: a new identity earns full weight only after trading with 12 counterparties in 10 epochs, each above 5 POA. Closed loops are flagged: a cluster swapping cedar timber among itself, or one opal for jade passed back and forth, scores near zero and stays weightless. Faking it costs 12 bought trades per identity at 50 POA each, so 100 fakes burn 60,000 POA, while honest trades are real business and cost nothing extra.
